title: Cosmonaut fooled crewmate with ice particles as 'UFO fleet'

tellings.quote: one of them told this story that he

plain: A Swedish UFO researcher named Clas Svahn, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, passes on a story he says a cosmonaut, a Soviet or Russian space traveller, told him. According to Svahn, the cosmonaut played a joke on a crewmate in their space capsule, passing off floating ice particles outside as a fleet of UFOs. Svahn tells it as a case of how ordinary things in space can be taken for something stranger.
